purpose: Independently judge reproducibility and completeness of Nonogram research evidence, including valid negative findings.

execution.instructions: Review research evidence only, not a product fix or release. Read retained patch, scoped check, full original baseline and candidate measurement/sidecar artifacts. Require reproducible synthetic request/selection/exclusions, initial and advanced seeds, attempts, phases/work/nodes/allocations, outcomes/failures and cold timing for all requested cases. evidence_status=provided alone proves retention, not completeness. Missing, malformed or truncated evidence is not a completed study. Require unchanged single 10-second request clock, work/cancellation/invariant bounds and original controls; reject production algorithm/RNG/order/grade, gameplay, logging, dependency/generated or acceptance changes. A complete supported negative/not-reproduced finding with explicit lost-seed uncertainty is valid. Do not infer an optimization or original-timeout fix. Require fresh engine/generator per sample, no cache hits, actual nonzero bounded work and one deadline across seed rounds; distinguish native work from total request work. Source is read-only; no edits, retesting, Git, agents or external actions. Return ready only for complete defensible evidence, with conclusion REPRODUCED or NOT_REPRODUCED and summary <=240 characters. Concrete in-scope evidence gaps return changes_requested with conclusion INCOMPLETE; capability/material-decision blockers return blocked. Never approve product code or release.
